p13/esc410:1.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:1.text: I've been better. I just buried my dog yesterday

p13/esc410:10.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:10.text: Was that your only pet? Or do you have others? We moved from FL to KY and the little dog just hung out here, he really belonged to the neighbor's son who didn't want him, so he just ran around wild and wouldn't leave. I never had a dog, but it got cold, so i took him in. They never asked about him and after a week, I asked them if I could have the dog, so they said yes. I don't think they cared.

p13/esc410:11.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:11.text: I wish I could give you a hug, really, there are no words to make this better as you already know the grief of losing a pet, it does get better, but it stings terribly at first.

p13/esc410:12.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:12.text: I have 2 other dogs that are mine and my boyfriend has 2

p13/esc410:13.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:13.text: Thank you. that means a lot

p13/esc410:14.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:14.text: We both had dogs when we met.

p13/esc410:15.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:15.text: So you definitely are a dog lover! I was in my 50s before I ever had a dog, now I wish I had more, they are really loving. Not like cats who don't care much about much except FOOD! lol

p13/esc410:16.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:16.text: I know when tragedy happens, I can't get stuck in depression, I sort of have to force myself to put one foot in front of the other. It's hard to have a healthy balance between grieving and continuing to live. Cry, then dry my eyes, pick up, go for a walk, don't get caught in grief, but yet don't deny it!

p13/esc410:17.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:17.text: They get to be so close and you can really pick up on their emotions and stuff. That's what happens to me. I get stuck sometimes

p13/esc410:18.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:18.text: I get stuck too. But you are doing the right things, here you reached out to someone and I do care, so you are moving forward.

p13/esc410:19.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:19.text: I always find it helpful just so have someone share my pain with me. Just to know I'm  not alone.

p13/esc410:2.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:2.text: She was going to turn 15 next month

p13/esc410:20.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:20.text: Thanks. Another person who has pets helps

p13/esc410:22.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:22.text: I do understand. My mom died in 2010, right after she died, 1 of my cats died, my husband went into the hospital and almost died, so we went on vacation so I would not be consumed with grief, and do you know, we brought our pets and our cat died when we arrived here on vacation?  I will never forget that. You know what. I knew I could either get consumed in grief, or push through. Man, that was hard. I prayed a lot and God got me through that and I had a good vacation, all things considered.

p13/esc410:23.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:23.text: I will definitely pray for you too that God will comfort your heart and that you will be comforted by your other dogs and your boyfriend's dogs and that you will feel joy at times at the happy memories you had with your dog.

p13/esc410:24.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:24.text: Oh wow, that sounds horrible. Pushing through though I guess is all one can do then. Thank you so much. I believe in prayer.

p13/esc410:25.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:25.text: Prayer is what gets me through every day!  :D  It was rough, but I believe these hard times strengthen us in some way. Because life throws hard balls, and we have to move forward or be consumed.

p13/esc410:26.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:26.text: That's true. I'm glad I did this project. You really helped me.

p13/esc410:27.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:27.text: I'm so glad I did too. It was a pleasure to meet you. And once again, (hug). :D

p13/esc410:28.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:28.text: You too. Thanks so much. bye

p13/esc410:29.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:29.text: I have one more thing to say - wise words from this 92 year old lady at church named Sue. She told me this after my brother died. When you get older, everyone you know is practically dead.  She said "Life is for the living, if you get caught up to much in all the death, you won't life."  True words. God bless, have a good night.

p13/esc410:3.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:3.text: Ouch! I'm so sorry to hear that. I never lost a dog, but I've lost cats.

p13/esc410:4.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:4.text: Is 14 a good age for a dog?

p13/esc410:5.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:5.text: I have my first dog so I don't know much, he is 9 years old and came with our house.

p13/esc410:6.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:6.text: Actually, yes. She was old and had dementia.

p13/esc410:7.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:7.text: The oldest dog I evet had was 15

p13/esc410:8.speaker: supporter
p13/esc410:8.text: I'm so sorry, losing a pet is very hard on us.

p13/esc410:9.speaker: seeker
p13/esc410:9.text: How did your dog come with the house?

p13/esc585:0.speaker: supporter
p13/esc585:0.text: HI there, how are you doing?

p13/esc585:10.speaker: supporter
p13/esc585:10.text: Ha, well that could get interesting

p13/esc585:12.speaker: seeker
p13/esc585:12.text: anyway, thanks for the chat. this was helpful

p13/esc585:2.speaker: supporter
p13/esc585:2.text: Do you want to talk about whats going on right now?

p13/esc585:3.speaker: seeker
p13/esc585:3.text: Sure. I took a nude photo of myself to share with someone I'm dating, and accidentally sent it to several friends in a group chat

p13/esc585:4.speaker: seeker
p13/esc585:4.text: I'm really embarrassed about it and I have some anxiety about meeting or talking to my friends

p13/esc585:5.speaker: supporter
p13/esc585:5.text: Ive done some things like that before. I know this might sound weird but what helped me through it was to actually own it. Take control of it before they can.

p13/esc585:6.speaker: seeker
p13/esc585:6.text: Do you think it would be helpful to use humor? I don't want them to tease me about it but I don't know how else to approach it

p13/esc585:7.speaker: supporter
p13/esc585:7.text: Yea that is definitely one way to control it

p13/esc585:8.speaker: seeker
p13/esc585:8.text: Lol maybe some of my friends will share with the group too

p13/esc585:9.speaker: seeker
p13/esc585:9.text: that would definitely make me feel better about it

p13/p13_conv_1:0.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:0.text: Hi Linda, how have you been feeling lately?

p13/p13_conv_1:1.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:1.text: Hey. Honestly, it's been a tough week. Losing Max still feels so raw.

p13/p13_conv_1:10.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:10.text: That can definitely be challenging. What do you think is making it hard to accept his support?

p13/p13_conv_1:11.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:11.text: I guess I've always been independent. Relying on someone else feels foreign to me.

p13/p13_conv_1:12.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:12.text: That makes sense. Sometimes accepting support is part of growing together. It can be a way to strengthen your bond.

p13/p13_conv_1:13.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:13.text: You're right, and I do appreciate him being here. It's a learning process for both of us.

p13/p13_conv_1:14.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:14.text: Absolutely. It's important to give yourself grace during this time.

p13/p13_conv_1:15.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:15.text: I appreciate that. Talking about Max and his wagging tail makes me smile, even if it's bittersweet.

p13/p13_conv_1:16.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:16.text: Those memories can be quite comforting. Maybe you and David can create a little tribute to Max?

p13/p13_conv_1:17.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:17.text: That's a beautiful idea. I think it might help me honor his memory positively.

p13/p13_conv_1:18.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:18.text: I'm glad you think so. Remember, it's okay to grieve and to find comforting ways to remember Max.

p13/p13_conv_1:19.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:19.text: Thank you for your support. This conversation has really helped me see things from a different perspective.

p13/p13_conv_1:2.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:2.text: I'm really sorry to hear that. It sounds like Max meant a lot to you.

p13/p13_conv_1:20.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:20.text: You're welcome, Linda. I'm here for you anytime you need to talk.

p13/p13_conv_1:21.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:21.text: I appreciate that a lot. I'll talk to David about your suggestion tonight.

p13/p13_conv_1:22.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:22.text: Great. I'm sure it'll be a meaningful and healing experience for both of you.

p13/p13_conv_1:3.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:3.text: He really did. Max was more than just a pet; he was part of the family.

p13/p13_conv_1:4.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:4.text: I can imagine it's like a part of your daily life is missing now. How are you coping?

p13/p13_conv_1:5.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:5.text: It helps that David moved in. It's comforting not to be alone in the apartment.

p13/p13_conv_1:6.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:6.text: That's good to hear. Having David around must provide some relief. How is the adjustment going?

p13/p13_conv_1:7.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:7.text: It's good, but I feel guilty sometimes. Like I'm burdening him with my grief.

p13/p13_conv_1:8.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_1:8.text: It's understandable to feel that way, but remember, it's okay to lean on someone you trust.

p13/p13_conv_1:9.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_1:9.text: Yeah, he keeps saying he wants to be there for me, but I'm still struggling to accept help.

p13/p13_conv_2:0.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:0.text: Hi Linda, how are you holding up today?

p13/p13_conv_2:1.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:1.text: Hey, I'm not doing too great. I had a big argument with Lily about family stuff.

p13/p13_conv_2:10.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:10.text: Guilt can be so tough to deal with. But remember, you're only human. You're allowed to set boundaries and take care of yourself.

p13/p13_conv_2:11.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:11.text: I know, but it's hard to shake off. I want things to be okay between Lily and me.

p13/p13_conv_2:12.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:12.text: I understand. It shows how much you care about your relationship with her. Have you thought about how you might approach things with Lily moving forward?

p13/p13_conv_2:13.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:13.text: I've been thinking of reaching out and talking it over calmly. I don't want this to become a bigger issue.

p13/p13_conv_2:14.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:14.text: That sounds like a really thoughtful approach. Clear communication might help both of you understand each other better.

p13/p13_conv_2:15.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:15.text: I hope so. I just hate being in this kind of conflict. It feels exhausting.

p13/p13_conv_2:16.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:16.text: Conflicts can be really draining, but resolving them can also lead to stronger bonds. You're strong for facing it head-on.

p13/p13_conv_2:17.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:17.text: Thanks for saying that. I guess I'll try to focus on the good side of it.

p13/p13_conv_2:18.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:18.text: Absolutely. Lean on David too; he's there to support you. How are things going with him?

p13/p13_conv_2:19.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:19.text: He's been great, actually. Moving in together has been a big help for me emotionally, especially after losing my dog.

p13/p13_conv_2:2.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. It must be hard having a fight with someone close to you. What happened, if you feel like sharing?

p13/p13_conv_2:20.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:20.text: It's wonderful to hear you have that support. David seems like a solid rock for you during tough times.

p13/p13_conv_2:21.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:21.text: Yeah, he's been amazing. I think I'll talk to him more about how I'm feeling too.

p13/p13_conv_2:3.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:3.text: We've always had different views on family responsibilities, but this time it got really heated. She thinks I'm not doing enough.

p13/p13_conv_2:4.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:4.text: That sounds really stressful. It must be tough feeling like your efforts aren't recognized.

p13/p13_conv_2:5.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:5.text: Yeah, exactly. I'm trying to help as much as I can, especially with work being so demanding.

p13/p13_conv_2:6.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:6.text: Balancing work and family can be really challenging. You're doing your best, and it sounds like you're being stretched thin.

p13/p13_conv_2:7.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:7.text: I just feel overwhelmed sometimes. I want to be there for my family but also need to take care of myself.

p13/p13_conv_2:8.speaker: supporter
p13/p13_conv_2:8.text: It's completely understandable to feel that way. It's important to find a balance that works for you, too.

p13/p13_conv_2:9.speaker: seeker
p13/p13_conv_2:9.text: Then there’s the guilt. I keep thinking about how maybe I should be doing more.

8b8b9b30d36540a63d202e8fdc2709fd37d41b84.head: ME
8b8b9b30d36540a63d202e8fdc2709fd37d41b84.statement: found supporter's suggestion to 'own' the situation helpful in managing emotional response

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: anyway, thanks for the chat. this was helpful
